commit.message:
lncli: only update the policy fields that are passed

updatechanpolicy no longer requires base_fee_msat, fee_rate and
time_lock_delta on every call; fields that aren't passed keep their
current value. The flags are now string flags parsed explicitly, which
removes the misleading "(default: 0)" from the help text and rejects
invalid input instead of treating it as zero.

Individual fields are set with the flags. Positional arguments are only
accepted when all three fields are set, since it's otherwise ambiguous
which field a value fills. A trailing channel point is recognised by its
colon, so it's never read as a policy field, and any argument left over
after the policy values and one channel point is rejected.

An lnd that predates partial updates would reset an omitted fee to zero,
so lncli checks the version first and refuses such an update.

Fixes #1523.

multi: allow a policy update to keep existing fields

Turn BaseFee, FeeRate and TimeLockDelta of ChannelPolicy into options,
so the local channel manager leaves the matching fields of the current
edge untouched when they're empty. UpdateChannelPolicy keeps setting all
three.

commit.message:
lnrpc: add partial_update to PolicyUpdateRequest

PolicyUpdateRequest can't tell an unset base fee, fee rate or time lock
delta from zero, so every update has to send all three. Add an opt-in
partial_update message that marks which of the three fields to apply,
so callers can update individual fields. Without partial_update the
existing semantics are unchanged, as current clients rely on omitted
(zero) values being applied.

Fixes #1523.

commit.message:
discovery: fix flaky TestGossipSyncerSyncTransitions

The test asserted an exact FirstTimestamp for the GossipTimestampRange
message the syncer sends when (re)entering active sync. The syncer
stamps the message with its own clock while processing the start or
transition request, and the test sampled time.Now() for its expectation
only afterwards. If a wall-clock second boundary was crossed in
between, the expectation was one second ahead of the stamped value and
the test failed, as seen in CI [1]:

    expected: FirstTimestamp 1794500870
    got:      FirstTimestamp 1794500869

Sample the time before starting the syncer and assert that the stamped
first timestamp falls within [startTime, now] instead of comparing
exact values.

[1]: https://github.com/lightningnetwork/lnd/actions/runs/42982273166/job/131243808607

commit.message:
invoices: require complete payment collection

In this commit, we distinguish failed released HTLCs from attempts
canceled before preimage release. Once every released HTLC has a final
outcome, an ordinary invoice is settled only if all were collected.
Otherwise we cancel it while retaining the amount actually received.
Persisting the failed state keeps this decision independent of outcome
order and restart.

Expose failed collection and the release decision through RPC. Preserve
the first settlement index when later duplicates finish. Backend,
recovery, replay and RPC regressions cover the persisted outcome
contract. AMP settlement is unchanged.

Signed-off-by: Olaoluwa Osuntokun <laolu32@gmail.com>

commit.message:
itest: preserve MPP siblings across restart

Send ordinary MPP shards alongside a fresh child of a settled AMP set
using real onions and the persistent replay log. Require normal HTLC
rejection for the closed set while the ordinary invoice is accepted.

Release the ordinary hold preimage with its payer offline, restart the
receiver, and verify reconnection establishes final invoice credit and
the expected channel balances. Reuse existing stream and restart helpers
without adding goroutines or production hooks.
